title: Google Is Putting AI Chats Right On the Homepage - Slashdot

content_html: Google is rolling out a redesigned desktop homepage that adds a collapsible sidebar for accessing and continuing previous AI Mode searches. Google's vice president of product, Robby Stein, says the company is rolling out the option because "people are coming to Search with more questions that aren't just one and done," adding that "in testing, this sidebar made a big difference for making progress & continuing to explore the web." The Verge reports: It's yet another big change for Google's homepage, which has long presented you with a single bar to kick off your web search. The company brought its AI Mode button to its search bar last year, which opens up a chatbot-like search experience within Google. In May, Google updated its search box to accommodate longer queries and added AI-powered autocomplete.
